slots.image_prompt: Minimalist, grand cover background in a clean light palette. A deep Klein blue (#002FA7) field overlaid with delicate geometric line work—long thin diagonal and horizontal strokes suggesting code, structure, and engineering precision. Soft off-white (#ECEFF1) negative space occupies the upper left for large serif title placement. One small warm orange (#E64A19) circular accent in the lower right corner, subtle and refined. Aesthetic: editorial, spacious, premium, low-contrast, no text, no letters, no logos, no numbers, no penguin, no characters. Mood: dignified, focused, contemporary.

Elegant section divider background in a light palette. Klein blue (#002FA7) soft rectangular block occupying the left third, gently fading into a light neutral (#ECEFF1) grid of ultra-fine horizontal and vertical lines on the right. A single small warm orange (#E64A19) dot as a punctuation mark near the block edge. Abundant clean negative space, generous whitespace, no text, no numbers, no letters, no icons, no timeline markers. Style: minimalist, editorial, sophisticated, quiet, generous, contemporary Swiss-style layout.

Abstract radial network visualization symbolizing global open-source collaboration. A central Klein blue (#002FA7) glowing node radiates thin elegant connection lines outward to dozens of smaller nodes scattered organically across a soft off-white (#ECEFF1) background. Concentric faint circular rings suggest worldwide reach. A few select nodes highlighted in warm orange (#E64A19) as accents. Style: minimalist, editorial infographic aesthetic, refined, subtle depth, no text, no labels, no numbers, no country names, no letters, no logos. Mood: connected, intelligent, expansive.

Clean dashboard-style background with a subtle grid texture in a light palette. Soft off-white (#ECEFF1) base overlaid with a very faint blueprint grid of thin lines in pale Klein blue (#002FA7) at low opacity. A slightly darker Klein blue tonal block in the upper left for hierarchy. One small warm orange (#E64A19) accent line as a delicate highlight. Abundant negative space for overlaying large numeric KPI content. No text, no numbers, no letters, no charts, no bars, no icons, no data visualization. Style: minimalist, premium, editorial, structured.

Sophisticated section divider background in a light palette. Soft off-white (#ECEFF1) base with two oversized elegant serif quotation marks in subtle Klein blue (#002FA7) at low opacity, positioned asymmetrically—one in the upper right, one in the lower left—creating a balanced diagonal rhythm. A thin warm orange (#E64A19) underline accent suggests an editorial callout. Generous central whitespace for title placement. No text, no words, no letters other than the abstract quotation glyphs, no numbers, no icons. Style: minimalist, editorial, literary, refined.

Minimalist decorative composition featuring one large elegant serif quotation mark in deep Klein blue (#002FA7), occupying most of the frame with graceful curves and calligraphic weight. A soft off-white (#ECEFF1) background with a gentle paper-grain texture. A small warm orange (#E64A19) square accent balances the composition in the opposite corner. Editorial, magazine-column aesthetic, sophisticated and calm. No text, no letters, no words, no numbers, no additional punctuation. Style: clean, typographic ornament, premium.

Abstract minimalist data-structure tree visualization as a conceptual metaphor. A root node in deep Klein blue (#002FA7) at the top branches downward through clean thin lines to multiple child and grandchild nodes, illustrating hierarchical relationships. Nodes rendered as soft rounded shapes with subtle drop shadows. A few nodes highlighted in warm orange (#E64A19) to suggest importance. Background is soft off-white (#ECEFF1). Style: editorial infographic, calm, precise, no labels, no text, no numbers, no letters, no brackets, no syntax. Mood: structured, elegant, foundational.

Two-column contrast composition symbolizing a before-and-after transformation. The left half carries a subtle Klein blue (#002FA7) tonal wash, suggesting intensity and edge. The right half shifts into a softer warmer neutral with a faint warm orange (#E64A19) tonal tint, suggesting growth and reflection. A single ultra-thin vertical hairline of light Klein blue divides the two columns. Base is off-white (#ECEFF1). No text, no words, no letters, no numbers, no icons, no symbols, no dividing arrows. Style: minimalist, editorial, poetic, balanced.

Subtle action-card background with a soft Klein blue (#002FA7) rounded rectangle shape occupying most of the frame, gently blending into an off-white (#ECEFF1) border. Inside the rectangle, an ultra-fine geometric dot grid pattern in slightly lighter blue adds quiet texture. A small warm orange (#E64A19) triangular corner accent in one corner suggests forward momentum. Editorial, minimal, confident. No text, no letters, no words, no numbers, no arrows, no checkmarks, no icons, no buttons. Style: clean, structured, inviting.

Minimalist closing-page background in a light palette. Predominantly generous soft off-white (#ECEFF1) whitespace suggesting calm conclusion and reflection. A subtle Klein blue (#002FA7) tonal wash in the lower third as a grounding base. One thin warm orange (#E64A19) horizontal line as a quiet punctuation mark. The lower-right quadrant is intentionally left clean and empty, reserved for a QR-code placeholder overlay. No text, no words, no letters, no numbers, no actual QR code, no logos, no icons. Style: minimalist, editorial, serene, editorial-book-closing feel.
